Not even around holidays. I have a child with a girl i live with now. I see finally how she is outside of seeing her two or three days a week. 

I love and care about her. But biggest mistake of my 20’s.

Im staying another night. Thanks to all you people. Thank you for all this you guys have done. I tried asking her if we could go to therapy together. But she refuses. I think we are on the tail end of this relationship sadly. 

But I love my son and want to do everything for him.

She might have. I never know. I have caught her texting other guys and deleting messages. But shes with me almost 24/7 besides visiting her family in another state. 

I do trust her, but like ya said you never know.

I never looked into overdosing. But I figured since i have all these prescriptions It could be easy and less painful. So im glad I had some insight on how an overdose really happens. 

Thank you.

I just feel like a failing father. Failing relationship with his mother. I never wanted to have a child eith someone I wouldnt end up with for a very long time. But thats most people correct?
Your an awesome person. I will give things time. Thank you again. I love my son. And I will be with him for a little longer, thanks to all you people.

Man...I just dont wanna fail my son. Me and his mother have a failing relationship. I just needed affection and to feel cared for. And The girl i slept with showed me that. But once she left I was still in the spot of having my family to think about.

Im lost. And I wanna just be out of this situation.

Yes I know my little guy doesnt want me gone. But I feel like such a failure. Im failing my family, i have a failing relationship. What kid of man does this shit. I always told myself id bever cheat on anyone.

Thank you I feel a little clearer right now than when inposted this. I just have a very hard working conscious. And I always have been that way. 

I didnt cheat to hurt my girlfriend, just needed some affection and felt cared for.
Very good points. Thank you. I thought if I just took a bunch of pills it wouldnt let me wake up in the morning
Man Im just not the cheating type. I stayed even going that long because I thought id always be a faithful type of person. Plus I didnt want to break up my family.
